_about: CRL metadata-annotation registry — the canonical tag vocabulary, value shapes, cardinality, and lifecycle for `@tag` annotations carried on `- meta is `@tag: <body>`.` lines. Consumed by the (future) Validator; human companion is metadata-model.md in this folder.
statusNote: Core vocabulary stable (two design-review rounds). v0.2.0 adds the review-flag tags per KE #203 (additive; two further design-review rounds — disc 220). ENFORCEMENT (Todo 3 / #154): the Validator now enforces vocabulary (malformed/unknown `@tag` → warning), field shape (required/enum/duplicate), cardinality, and the open-flag warning — via `MetaTagValidator` reading the compile-time-inlined registry. REMAINDER (#154 follow-up): the family-C extraction-exhaust rules (`run`-required, re-run staleness) + the re-add-detection guard are not yet enforced. Ref schemes (kg:/reef:) are illustrative. Renames go through `aliases`.

carrier.terminator: the `.` goes AFTER the closing backtick: - meta is `...`.
carrier.scopeNote: The `meta` carrier parses on `concept` (metaLine* in conceptBody), `decision` (leading metaLine* in decisionBody), and `library` (trailing metaLine* on libraryStatement) — KE #203 Todo 2 (grammar) + Todo 3/#154 (validator).
carrier.backCompat: A meta line with no leading @tag is a legitimate untyped note and passes validation.

families.A-external-ref: Scored hints to an external store. Candidates are extraction-derived (replace-by-run); confirmed are durable.

flagModel._about: A `flag` (a tag with `flag: true`) is a narrative->CRL problem or a validation concern that BLOCKS Medical Validation completion while open. ONE mechanism; two categories by origin (KE #203, disc 220).

categories.extraction: an EXTRACTION flag — authored by the AI during narrative->CRL extraction (source-ambiguity / source-contradiction / unsettled fork / encoding-infidelity). The tags: customer-confirmable, internal-inconsistency, open-fork, fidelity-defect.
categories.validation: a VALIDATION flag — authored by a HUMAN during Medical Validation (a concern raised while validating). Same behavior as an extraction flag; the validation-flag carrier + tag land with the MV cockpit surface (Todo 4).

flagModel.status: open | resolved (NO deferred). `open` blocks mvComplete + emits; `resolved` persists (learning signal) + does not emit.
flagModel.mvComplete: the real gate: mvComplete = (every MV case is `pass`) AND (no `open` flags). Resolved flags do NOT block it. Surfaced in the MV cockpit (Todo 4).
flagModel.lifecycle: agent/human authors `open` -> human RESOLVES to `resolved` IN MV (open<->resolved only; MV NEVER deletes) -> the separate LEARNING system consumes + DELETES `resolved` flags (backlog; not MV, not this feature).
flagModel.transitions: state changes happen in the MV cockpit: a warning badge on the tree START NODE while any flag is `open` -> the flag list -> per-flag open<->resolved toggle -> the cockpit edits the `.crl` META line (metadata-only; never the decision logic).
flagModel.emit: open flags emit to CQL as normal meta-tag behavior (a KE reads them in generated CQL); resolved flags do NOT emit (noise). Orthogonal to mvComplete.
flagModel.reAddGuard: a resolved flag's `key` (normalized source-span/hash) suppresses re-add on re-extraction while the source problem persists; correcting the source removes it cleanly.

tags.lifecycleNote: DELETE when the CRL no longer depends on the gap. Delete-on-fix is DELIBERATE here (unlike the review flags): the durable record lives in the FILED ISSUE, not inline.

plannedEmit.condition: emit as a CQL block comment — a visible tracked gap, like @business-logic-deferred. Todo 4.

tags.notes: A durable POINTER to a filed gap/issue — NOT a flag (no `flag`, no `warnWhileOpen`, no `status`; does not block mvComplete): a filed gap is managed work that ships fine (like `// TODO(#123)`). Requires `; ref <issue>`. Covers the KE's @stage-boundary case when the gap is FILED; the un-filed 'stage/language can't express this' cases REUSE @crl-future-expression (language limit) / @business-logic-deferred / @clinical-logic-deferred (deferred logic).

validatorRules: value-shape mismatch (e.g. @kg-concept missing ref; confidence outside [0,1]; rank < 1) -> error
cardinality violation (e.g. two @description on one concept) -> error
malformed-tag lint: a meta line starting '@' but not matching ^@[a-z][a-z0-9-]*: -> warning (probable malformed tag — catches silent demotion to an untyped note)
a meta line NOT starting '@' -> legitimate untyped note (back-compat), no diagnostic
re-run staleness: warn if two distinct run ids' family-C / candidate-ref exhaust coexist on one concept
family-C tags and candidate (status=candidate) external refs MUST carry `run` -> error if omitted (otherwise the re-run replace match key is undefined)

flag (`flag:true`) with status=open (or status absent -> defaults open) -> WARNING (open flag — blocks mvComplete; resolve in MV). The mvComplete predicate (Todo 3) consumes this: mvComplete = all cases pass AND no open flags.

flag RE-ADD GUARD: an extractor MUST NOT emit a flag whose `key` matches an existing status=resolved tombstone on the same target (the source property persists, but the human resolution stands). A genuinely-new instance (different `key` / source-span) MAY be added. See `flagModel.reAddGuard`.
@gap-filed without a `ref` -> error (a filed gap needs its issue id)
flags use status open|resolved ONLY -> a flag with status=deferred is an error (deferred/tracked work is @gap-filed or @business-logic-deferred, not a flag)
reRunReplaceRule: On re-extraction, the producer replaces the prior run's family-C tags (semantic-parse-text) and candidate (status=candidate) external refs for a concept, matched by by/run. Confirmed refs and family-B durable tags (id, description, ke-feedback, logic-expression-text, controlled-natural-language, crl-future-expression, business-logic-deferred, clinical-logic-deferred, cql-comment, customer-confirmable, internal-inconsistency, open-fork, fidelity-defect, gap-filed) are never auto-replaced. Refs with status=rejected or status=superseded are durable historical records (preserved across re-runs so negative review work isn't lost). FLAG RE-ADD GUARD (`flag:true`): a resolved flag tombstone is durable; on re-extraction the producer MUST NOT re-add a review flag whose `key` matches an existing status=resolved tombstone on the same target — matched by (tag id + attachment `@id` + `key`, where `key` is a normalized source-span/hash). Prevents a persistent source contradiction from re-opening a flag the human already resolved.
